trigger.finding: Thinking-enabled Qwen3.5 can use the entire 4096-token completion without public content. Direct Prime Inference supports chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false for a separate public pass.

generation_contract: Run the frozen council prompt once with enable_thinking=true and retain reasoning_content privately.
Fail if the deliberation pass does not return reasoning_content; public content from this pass is not used.
Append the private deliberation to the same frozen council prompt inside a nonpublic delimiter.
Run the publication prompt with enable_thinking=false and retain only its public content.
Fail if the publication pass has no public content or unexpectedly returns reasoning_content.
Only public content enters the next participant's council history.
